name: suspension hamstring runner
description: A hamstring curl with heels in straps, alternating legs like running. It trains the hamstrings and core control.
instructions: Lie on your back with both heels in the straps and lift your hips.
Press your arms into the floor for balance.
Curl one heel toward your glutes while the other leg extends.
Switch legs in a smooth running rhythm.
Keep your hips high and level.
